Frequently
Asked Questions

What is a Runable workflow?+

A workflow is a guided sequence for a specific task, such as preparing a meeting brief, creating a video, or researching a company.

What do I need to get started?+

Choose a workflow to see its required inputs. Depending on the task, you may need a prompt, a link, files, or access to a connected app.

Can I adjust a workflow to my needs?+

Bring your context, preferences, and source material. You can review and refine the result as you work with Runable.

Do I need to connect my apps?+

Only when the task needs information or actions from another app. Other workflows start with text, uploaded files, or public links.

What if I cannot find the workflow I need?+

Describe your task in Runable to start a conversation around your own goal.
